## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.20.22

### Security Modes
- Updates SBS50 Home and Away arming responses so blocked-arm notifications are handled separately from actual mode changes.
- Keeps direct force-arm automation actions separate from the confirmation prompt.

### Cameras and Recordings
- Improves camera event matching, duplicate-event handling, and snapshot updates when detections arrive close together.
- Updates live-view session cleanup when a viewer closes or a connection is interrupted.
- Loads additional recording-history pages and refreshes expired playback links.
- Preserves other viewers' playback sessions when one viewer leaves the recordings panel.

### Local Storage
- Tracks recording ownership per integration entry so clearing one entry preserves recordings retained by another.
- Improves retention cleanup, abandoned temporary-file cleanup, and coordination with active playback.
- Keeps manually deleted recordings out of background downloads and updates storage-path guidance.

### Devices and Connections
- Updates end-of-life state handling, combined smoke/CO alarm presentation, and thermo-hygrometer switch updates.
- Updates radon unit settings and integer-only sensitivity commands.
- Preserves observed device identities across reloads and improves connection cleanup during setup and unload.
- Distinguishes temporary login-service failures from invalid credentials.

### Languages and Documentation
- Completes missing entity names, action messages, and recording-option translations across all previously supported languages.
- Improves device-lifetime and recording-interval wording.
- Updates translated recording-storage and notification-automation documentation.
